text: page is good. only if you can still search across all pages and it brings the relevant result into view without needing to go find it in a set of pages
resolution: Replaced the prop menu's unscannable wall of ~100 text pills with a paged PICTURE browser (new PropBrowser.tsx; CatalogRail's prop tab delegates to it, other tabs keep pills). Shaped around the reconciler's real limits (no list virtualization; a live Scene3D per tile is the heavy path): the visible set is BOUNDED to a page of 12 thumbnails with prev/next so hundreds are never mounted at once; each tile is a one-prop Scene3D wrapped in a StaticSurface keyed by prop kind so its paint collapses to a cached quad and survives paging back; and SEARCH is flat across the ENTIRE catalog (every category) with the hits rendered in place — no page-hunting, the user's explicit requirement. Bundles clean; hot-reloads in dev. This is the de-risk prototype: it answers whether ~12 bounded thumbnails perform (else we go to offline disk-cached bakes) and whether the fixed thumbnail camera frames props recognizably (else per-prop auto-framing). Committed a2b647c52, awaiting the user's dev test.
